rationale: The calculated timescales are the basis of the objection.

sources.quote: We find that the decoherence timescales (∼ 10−13 − 10−20 seconds) are typically much shorter than the relevant dynamical timescales (∼ 10−3 − 10−1 seconds), both for regular neuron firing and for kink-like polarization excitations in microtubules.
